text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio suffers an injury during
training and I
take her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I said I'm fine! You're worrying over
nothing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
This thing will heal up in no time! I'll be
back in
action tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I won't let this slow me down! If I say I
can do it,
then―

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ouch!
choice_data_list: 無理はしないでほしい

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.
choice_data_list: 無理はしないでほしい

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Fine, but only today.
choice_data_list: せめて今日だけは安静に

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... And only because you asked me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I won't let something dumb like an injury
stop me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make sure Tokai Teio takes a proper
rest today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I can! I know I can!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: See?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: OW!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: ちゃんと1日休めば治るから

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio spends the entire day in a
very grumpy
mood.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer! I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm the invincible Tokai Teio,
remember?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're my trainer! You need to believe
in me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I fall, I always
get
right back up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following day, Teio shows up to
practice
looking even more formidable
than before.
